description: Operator: run a CLI in a cloned task workspace, then check → harvest. Dest merge is parked (operator_close). Grant ids load grants/<id>.yaml; inline grant.paths is not authority. Not a model tool. If task/preflight exists, exit 3 with a structured no-work receipt skips the CLI only after the ordinary task check passes. Claude/macOS work orders derive limits from the frozen spec, refuse supplied mismatches, enforce native turns/usage cost plus parent-owned native-tool admission, and bound checks. Other providers have no new enforcement claim. A spec naming repo: and lane: (ops/bin/_lanes.py; repos in ~/.contextstack/config/repos.json or CS_REPOS_FILE) runs the agent in the lane worktree <repo parent>/<lane> on branch lane/<lane>, sandboxed to that worktree and its git metadata; a pass commits on the lane branch (no hooks; the gate runs at cs land).

conversation_id.description: Director-owned conversation identity forwarded by tick, never spec or intent metadata.
